## ✅ แก้ไขโค้ดแบบเต็มทุกไฟล์ (Full Code Update)

จากโครงสร้างโปรเจกต์เดิม เราได้ทำการแก้ไขและเพิ่มไฟล์ต่างๆ ดังนี้ โดยคงโครงสร้างเดิมและป้องกันการทำงานผิดพลาด

---

### 📁 รายการไฟล์ที่แก้ไข/เพิ่ม

| ลำดับ | Path | สถานะ | คำอธิบาย |
|-------|------|--------|-----------|
| 1 | `pkg/helpers/alarm.go` | **สร้างใหม่** | ย้าย logic alarm จาก TypeScript มาที่ Go |
| 2 | `pkg/redis/redis_conn.go` | แก้ไข | เพิ่ม `Cache` interface และ `RedisCache` |
| 3 | `internal/modules/mqtt/presenter/presenter.go` | แก้ไข | เพิ่ม `MQTTTopicDataResponse` |
| 4 | `internal/modules/mqtt/usecase/usecase.go` | แก้ไข | เพิ่ม `GetTopic`, `saveToInflux`, ปรับ constructor รับ `influxClient`, แก้ไข handler |
| 5 | `internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/handler.go` | แก้ไข | เพิ่ม `cache` field, เพิ่ม `GetTopicData`, ปรับ constructor |
| 6 | `internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/routes.go` | แก้ไข | เพิ่ม route `GET /gettopicdata` |
| 7 | `internal/server/handlers.go` | แก้ไข | inject `redisCache` และ `influxClient` ไปยัง MQTT |

---

## 1. สร้างไฟล์ `pkg/helpers/alarm.go`

```go
// pkg/helpers/alarm.go
package helpers

import (
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// AlarmDetailDto ข้อมูลสำหรับประมวลผล alarm
type AlarmDetailDto struct {
	HardwareID        interface{} `json:"hardware_id"`
	ValueData         interface{} `json:"value_data"`
	ValueAlarm        interface{} `json:"value_alarm"`
	ValueRelay        interface{} `json:"value_relay"`
	ValueControlRelay interface{} `json:"value_control_relay"`
	Max               interface{} `json:"max"`
	Min               interface{} `json:"min"`
	StatusAlert       interface{} `json:"status_alert"`
	StatusWarning     interface{} `json:"status_warning"`
	RecoveryWarning   interface{} `json:"recovery_warning"`
	RecoveryAlert     interface{} `json:"recovery_alert"`
	DeviceName        string      `json:"device_name"`
	ActionName        string      `json:"action_name"`
	MqttName          string      `json:"mqtt_name"`
	MqttControlOn     string      `json:"mqtt_control_on"`
	MqttControlOff    string      `json:"mqtt_control_off"`
	CountAlarm        interface{} `json:"count_alarm"`
	Event             interface{} `json:"event"`
	Unit              string      `json:"unit"`
	SensorValueData   interface{} `json:"sensor_value_data"`
}

// AlarmDetailResult ผลลัพธ์การประมวลผล alarm
type AlarmDetailResult struct {
	Status             int         `json:"status"`
	AlarmStatusSet     int         `json:"alarm_status_set"`
	Title              string      `json:"title"`
	Subject            string      `json:"subject"`
	Content            string      `json:"content"`
	DataAlarm          interface{} `json:"data_alarm"`
	EventControl       string      `json:"event_control"`
	MessageMqttControl string      `json:"message_mqtt_control"`
	ValueData          float64     `json:"value_data"`
	SensorData         interface{} `json:"sensor_data"`
	Timestamp          time.Time   `json:"timestamp"`
	Lang               string      `json:"lang"`
}

// toFloat64 แปลง interface{} เป็น float64
func toFloat64(v interface{}) float64 {
	switch val := v.(type) {
	case float64:
		return val
	case float32:
		return float64(val)
	case int:
		return float64(val)
	case int64:
		return float64(val)
	case string:
		f, _ := strconv.ParseFloat(val, 64)
		return f
	default:
		return 0
	}
}

// toInt แปลง interface{} เป็น int
func toInt(v interface{}) int {
	return int(toFloat64(v))
}

// normalizeSensorValue ปรับค่าจาก ON/OFF หรือ string เป็นตัวเลข
func normalizeSensorValue(v interface{}) interface{} {
	switch val := v.(type) {
	case string:
		upper := strings.ToUpper(val)
		if upper == "ON" {
			return 1
		}
		if upper == "OFF" {
			return 0
		}
		if f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(val, 64); err == nil {
			return f
		}
		return val
	default:
		return val
	}
}

// AlarmDetailValidateTh ประมวลผลภาษาไทย
func AlarmDetailValidateTh(dto AlarmDetailDto) AlarmDetailResult {
	return processAlarm(dto, "th")
}

// AlarmDetailValidateEn ประมวลผลภาษาอังกฤษ
func AlarmDetailValidateEn(dto AlarmDetailDto) AlarmDetailResult {
	return processAlarm(dto, "en")
}

// AlarmDetailValidate ประมวลผลภาษาไทย (default)
func AlarmDetailValidate(dto AlarmDetailDto) AlarmDetailResult {
	return processAlarm(dto, "th")
}

// processAlarm core logic
func processAlarm(dto AlarmDetailDto, lang string) AlarmDetailResult {
	hardwareID := toInt(dto.HardwareID)
	sensorValueRaw := normalizeSensorValue(dto.ValueData)
	sensorValue := toFloat64(sensorValueRaw)
	valueAlarm := toFloat64(dto.ValueAlarm)
	maxVal := toFloat64(dto.Max)
	minVal := toFloat64(dto.Min)
	statusAlert := toFloat64(dto.StatusAlert)
	statusWarning := toFloat64(dto.StatusWarning)
	recoveryWarning := toFloat64(dto.RecoveryWarning)
	recoveryAlert := toFloat64(dto.RecoveryAlert)
	countAlarm := toFloat64(dto.CountAlarm)
	event := toInt(dto.Event)

	// ข้อความตามภาษา
	messages := map[string]string{
		"warning":           "Warning",
		"critical":          "Critical",
		"recovery_warning":  "Recovery Warning",
		"recovery_critical": "Recovery Critical",
		"normal":            "Normal",
		"critical_max":      "Critical! Maximum limit.",
		"critical_min":      "Critical! Minimum limit",
	}
	if lang == "th" {
		messages = map[string]string{
			"warning":           "คำเตือน มีความผิดปกติ",
			"critical":          "ภาวะวิกฤตต้องแก้ไขทันที",
			"recovery_warning":  "คืนสู่ภาวะปกติ (คำเตือน)",
			"recovery_critical": "คืนสู่ภาวะปกติ (วิกฤต)",
			"normal":            "ปกติ",
			"critical_max":      "วิกฤต มีค่าสูงเกินกำหนด",
			"critical_min":      "วิกฤต มีค่าต่ำกว่ากำหนด",
		}
	}

	status := 5          // default normal
	alarmStatusSet := 999
	title := messages["normal"]
	subject := messages["normal"]
	content := messages["normal"]
	dataAlarm := 0.0
	eventControl := fmt.Sprintf("%d", event)
	messageMqttControl := ""

	switch hardwareID {
	case 3: // IO Control
		if sensorValue == 1 {
			status = 5
			title = messages["normal"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["normal"])
			content = subject
		}
	case 4: // Critical Sensor
		if sensorValue != 1 {
			status = 2
			alarmStatusSet = 2
			title = messages["critical"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["critical"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = statusWarning
		} else {
			status = 5
		}
	default: // Sensor & IO Sensor
		if maxVal > 0 && sensorValue >= maxVal {
			status = 2
			alarmStatusSet = 2
			title = messages["critical_max"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["critical_max"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = statusWarning
		} else if minVal > 0 && sensorValue <= minVal {
			status = 1
			alarmStatusSet = 1
			title = messages["critical_min"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["critical_min"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = statusWarning
		} else if hardwareID == 1 && statusWarning > 0 && sensorValue >= statusWarning && sensorValue < statusAlert {
			status = 1
			alarmStatusSet = 1
			title = messages["warning"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["warning"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = statusWarning
		} else if hardwareID == 1 && statusAlert > 0 && sensorValue >= statusAlert {
			status = 2
			alarmStatusSet = 2
			title = messages["critical"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["critical"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = statusAlert
		} else if countAlarm >= 1 && recoveryWarning > 0 && sensorValue <= recoveryWarning {
			status = 3
			alarmStatusSet = 3
			title = messages["recovery_warning"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["recovery_warning"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = recoveryWarning
			if event == 1 {
				eventControl = "0"
				messageMqttControl = dto.MqttControlOff
			} else {
				eventControl = "1"
				messageMqttControl = dto.MqttControlOn
			}
		} else if countAlarm >= 1 && recoveryAlert > 0 && sensorValue <= recoveryAlert {
			status = 4
			alarmStatusSet = 4
			title = messages["recovery_critical"]
			subject = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s : %v %s", dto.DeviceName, messages["recovery_critical"], sensorValue, dto.Unit)
			content = subject
			dataAlarm = recoveryAlert
			if event == 1 {
				eventControl = "0"
				messageMqttControl = dto.MqttControlOff
			} else {
				eventControl = "1"
				messageMqttControl = dto.MqttControlOn
			}
		}
	}

	return AlarmDetailResult{
		Status:             status,
		AlarmStatusSet:     alarmStatusSet,
		Title:              title,
		Subject:            subject,
		Content:            content,
		DataAlarm:          dataAlarm,
		EventControl:       eventControl,
		MessageMqttControl: messageMqttControl,
		ValueData:          sensorValue,
		SensorData:         dto.SensorValueData,
		Timestamp:          time.Now(),
		Lang:               lang,
	}
}
```

## 2. แก้ไข `pkg/redis/redis_conn.go` (เพิ่ม Cache interface และ RedisCache)

```go
// pkg/redis/redis_conn.go
package redis

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"time"

	"icmongolang/config"

	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
)

func NewRedis(cfg *config.Config) *redis.Client {
	client := redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
		Addr:         cfg.Redis.Addr,
		MinIdleConns: cfg.Redis.MinIdleConns,
		PoolSize:     cfg.Redis.PoolSize,
		PoolTimeout:  time.Duration(cfg.Redis.PoolTimeout) * time.Second,
		Password:     cfg.Redis.Password,
		DB:           cfg.Redis.Db,
	})
	return client
}

var ctx = context.Background()

// RedisHelper คงเดิมเพื่อความเข้ากันได้
type RedisHelper struct {
	client *redis.Client
}

var instance *RedisHelper

func GetRedisHelper() *RedisHelper {
	if instance == nil {
		instance = &RedisHelper{
			client: redis.NewClient(&redis.Options{
				Addr:     "localhost:6380",
				Password: "",
				DB:       0,
			}),
		}
	}
	return instance
}

func (r *RedisHelper) Set(key string, value interface{}, ttlSeconds int) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return r.client.Set(ctx, key, data, time.Duration(ttlSeconds)*time.Second).Err()
}

func (r *RedisHelper) Get(key string, dest interface{}) error {
	data, err := r.client.Get(ctx, key).Bytes()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.Unmarshal(data, dest)
}

func (r *RedisHelper) Delete(key string) error {
	return r.client.Del(ctx, key).Err()
}

func (r *RedisHelper) Exists(key string) (bool, error) {
	n, err := r.client.Exists(ctx, key).Result()
	return n > 0, err
}

func (r *RedisHelper) TTL(key string) (time.Duration, error) {
	return r.client.TTL(ctx, key).Result()
}

func (r *RedisHelper) Keys(pattern string) ([]string, error) {
	return r.client.Keys(ctx, pattern).Result()
}

func (r *RedisHelper) FlushAll() error {
	return r.client.FlushAll(ctx).Err()
}

// ---------- เพิ่ม Cache interface และ RedisCache ----------
type Cache interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, key string, dst interface{}) error
	Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value interface{}, ttl time.Duration) error
}

// RedisCache implement Cache interface
type RedisCache struct {
	client *redis.Client
}

func NewCache(client *redis.Client) Cache {
	return &RedisCache{client: client}
}

func (c *RedisCache) Get(ctx context.Context, key string, dst interface{}) error {
	data, err := c.client.Get(ctx, key).Bytes()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return json.Unmarshal(data, dst)
}

func (c *RedisCache) Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value interface{}, ttl time.Duration) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return c.client.Set(ctx, key, data, ttl).Err()
}
```

```go
// internal/modules/mqtt/presenter/presenter.go
package presenter

import "time"

type PublishRequest struct {
	Topic    string      `json:"topic" validate:"required"`
	QoS      byte        `json:"qos" validate:"omitempty,min=0,max=2"`
	Retained bool        `json:"retained"`
	Payload  interface{} `json:"payload" validate:"required"`
}

type SubscribeRequest struct {
	Topic string `json:"topic" validate:"required"`
	QoS   byte   `json:"qos" validate:"omitempty,min=0,max=2"`
}

type UnsubscribeRequest struct {
	Topic string `json:"topic" validate:"required"`
}

type UnsubscribeResponse struct {
	Success bool   `json:"success"`
	Topic   string `json:"topic"`
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

type SubscriptionsResponse struct {
	Topics []string `json:"topics"`
	Count  int      `json:"count"`
}

type PublishResponse struct {
	Success bool   `json:"success"`
	Message string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

type SubscribeResponse struct {
	Topic        string    `json:"topic"`
	QoS          byte      `json:"qos"`
	SubscribedAt time.Time `json:"subscribed_at"`
	Message      string    `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

// MQTTTopicDataResponse ใช้สำหรับ GET /mqtt/gettopicdata
type MQTTTopicDataResponse struct {
	StatusCode int         `json:"statuscode"`
	Code       int         `json:"code"`
	Topic      string      `json:"topic"`
	Payload    interface{} `json:"payload"`
	From       string      `json:"from"` // "cache" or "mqtt"
	Timestamp  string      `json:"timestamp"`
	Message    string      `json:"message"`
}
```

## 4. แก้ไข `internal/modules/mqtt/usecase/usecase.go` (เต็มไฟล์)

```go
// internal/modules/mqtt/usecase/usecase.go
package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"icmongolang/config"
	"icmongolang/internal/modules/alarm/models"
	"icmongolang/internal/modules/mqtt/presenter"
	"icmongolang/internal/websocket"
	"icmongolang/pkg/influxdb"
	"icmongolang/pkg/logger"
	mqttPkg "icmongolang/pkg/mqtt"

	mqtt "github.com/eclipse/paho.mqtt.golang"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

type MQTTUseCase interface {
	Publish(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.PublishRequest) error
	Subscribe(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.SubscribeRequest) error
	Unsubscribe(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.UnsubscribeRequest) error
	GetSubscriptions() []string
	IsConnected() bool
	SaveAlarmLog(alarmStatus int, subject, content, deviceID string, valueData interface{}) error
	GetTopic(ctx context.Context, topic string, timeout time.Duration) ([]byte, error)
}

type AlarmLogRepository interface {
	Create(log *models.AlarmLog) error
}

type subscriptionInfo struct {
	QoS byte
}

type mqttUseCase struct {
	client        mqttPkg.Client
	cfg           *config.Config
	logger        logger.Logger
	subsMu        sync.RWMutex
	subscriptions map[string]subscriptionInfo
	wsHub         *websocket.Hub
	db            *gorm.DB
	alarmLogRepo  AlarmLogRepository
	influxClient  influxdb.Client
}

// NewMQTTUseCaseWithClientAndWS พร้อม InfluxDB
func NewMQTTUseCaseWithClientAndWS(
	client mqttPkg.Client,
	cfg *config.Config,
	log logger.Logger,
	wsHub *websocket.Hub,
	db *gorm.DB,
	alarmLogRepo AlarmLogRepository,
	influxClient influxdb.Client,
) (MQTTUseCase, error) {
	if !client.IsConnected() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("MQTT client not connected")
	}
	log.Info("MQTT usecase with WebSocket, DB & InfluxDB")
	return &mqttUseCase{
		client:        client,
		cfg:           cfg,
		logger:        log,
		subscriptions: make(map[string]subscriptionInfo),
		wsHub:         wsHub,
		db:            db,
		alarmLogRepo:  alarmLogRepo,
		influxClient:  influxClient,
	}, nil
}

// NewMQTTUseCaseWithClient ใช้ client เดิม (ไม่มี WebSocket, InfluxDB)
func NewMQTTUseCaseWithClient(client mqttPkg.Client, cfg *config.Config, log logger.Logger) (MQTTUseCase, error) {
	if !client.IsConnected() {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("MQTT client not connected")
	}
	log.Info("MQTT usecase using existing client")
	return &mqttUseCase{
		client:        client,
		cfg:           cfg,
		logger:        log,
		subscriptions: make(map[string]subscriptionInfo),
	}, nil
}

func (u *mqttUseCase) waitForConnection(timeout time.Duration) error {
	if u.client.IsConnected() {
		return nil
	}
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		if u.client.IsConnected() {
			return nil
		}
		time.Sleep(100 * time.Millisecond)
	}
	return fmt.Errorf("MQTT client not connected after %v", timeout)
}

// Publish ส่งข้อความ
func (u *mqttUseCase) Publish(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.PublishRequest) error {
	if err := u.waitForConnection(5 * time.Second); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	u.logger.Infof("Publishing to topic %s (QoS=%d, retained=%v)", req.Topic, req.QoS, req.Retained)
	return u.client.Publish(req.Topic, req.QoS, req.Retained, req.Payload)
}

// Subscribe ลงทะเบียนรับข้อความ
func (u *mqttUseCase) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.SubscribeRequest) error {
	if err := u.waitForConnection(5 * time.Second); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	u.logger.Infof("Subscribing to topic %s with QoS %d", req.Topic, req.QoS)

	u.subsMu.RLock()
	_, exists := u.subscriptions[req.Topic]
	u.subsMu.RUnlock()
	if exists {
		u.logger.Warnf("Already subscribed to topic %s, skipping", req.Topic)
		return nil
	}

	handler := func(client mqtt.Client, msg mqtt.Message) {
		payload := string(msg.Payload())
		u.logger.Infof("Received message on topic %s: %s", msg.Topic(), payload)

		// WebSocket broadcast
		if u.wsHub != nil {
			wsMsg := websocket.Message{
				Type:    "mqtt",
				Topic:   msg.Topic(),
				Payload: payload,
			}
			u.wsHub.BroadcastToAll(wsMsg)
		}

		// บันทึก InfluxDB (ไม่ block main routine)
		go u.saveToInflux(msg.Topic(), msg.Payload())

		// ตัวอย่างการตรวจจับ alarm
		if containsAlarmKeyword(msg.Topic()) {
			// TODO: parse payload เป็น AlarmDetailDto และเรียก helpers.AlarmDetailValidate
		}
	}

	if err := u.client.Subscribe(req.Topic, req.QoS, handler); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("subscribe failed: %w", err)
	}

	u.subsMu.Lock()
	u.subscriptions[req.Topic] = subscriptionInfo{QoS: req.QoS}
	u.subsMu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// Unsubscribe ยกเลิก订阅
func (u *mqttUseCase) Unsubscribe(ctx context.Context, req *presenter.UnsubscribeRequest) error {
	if err := u.waitForConnection(5 * time.Second); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	u.logger.Infof("Unsubscribing from topic %s", req.Topic)

	u.subsMu.RLock()
	_, exists := u.subscriptions[req.Topic]
	u.subsMu.RUnlock()
	if !exists {
		u.logger.Warnf("Topic %s not subscribed, skipping", req.Topic)
		return nil
	}

	if err := u.client.Unsubscribe(req.Topic); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsubscribe failed: %w", err)
	}

	u.subsMu.Lock()
	delete(u.subscriptions, req.Topic)
	u.subsMu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// GetSubscriptions คืนค่ารายชื่อ topic ที่กำลัง subscribe
func (u *mqttUseCase) GetSubscriptions() []string {
	u.subsMu.RLock()
	defer u.subsMu.RUnlock()
	topics := make([]string, 0, len(u.subscriptions))
	for topic := range u.subscriptions {
		topics = append(topics, topic)
	}
	return topics
}

// SaveAlarmLog บันทึก alarm log ลงฐานข้อมูล
func (u *mqttUseCase) SaveAlarmLog(alarmStatus int, subject, content, deviceID string, valueData interface{}) error {
	if u.alarmLogRepo == nil {
		return nil
	}
	now := time.Now()
	log := &models.AlarmLog{
		AlarmStatus: alarmStatus,
		Subject:     subject,
		Content:     content,
		DeviceID:    deviceID,
		DataAlarm:   fmt.Sprintf("%v", valueData),
		Date:        now.Format("2006-01-02"),
		Time:        now.Format("15:04:05"),
		CreatedAt:   now,
		UpdatedAt:   now,
	}
	return u.alarmLogRepo.Create(log)
}

func containsAlarmKeyword(topic string) bool {
	return strings.Contains(topic, "alarm") || strings.HasSuffix(topic, "/alarm")
}

// IsConnected สถานะการเชื่อมต่อ MQTT
func (u *mqttUseCase) IsConnected() bool {
	return u.client.IsConnected()
}

// GetTopic ดึงข้อมูลจาก topic แบบ request-response (subscribe รอ single message แล้ว unsubscribe)
func (u *mqttUseCase) GetTopic(ctx context.Context, topic string, timeout time.Duration) ([]byte, error) {
	if err := u.waitForConnection(timeout); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return u.client.GetDataFromTopic(ctx, topic, timeout)
}

// saveToInflux บันทึกข้อมูล MQTT ลง InfluxDB
func (u *mqttUseCase) saveToInflux(topic string, payload []byte) {
	if u.influxClient == nil {
		return
	}
	tags := map[string]string{"topic": topic}
	fields := map[string]interface{}{
		"payload": string(payload),
		"length":  len(payload),
	}
	var data map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &data); err == nil {
		for k, v := range data {
			if _, ok := v.(float64); ok {
				fields[k] = v
			}
		}
	}
	_ = u.influxClient.WritePoint("mqtt_messages", tags, fields, time.Now())
}
```

## 5. แก้ไข `internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/handler.go` (เต็มไฟล์)

```go
// internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/handler.go
package http

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/md5"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"icmongolang/internal/modules/mqtt/presenter"
	"icmongolang/internal/modules/mqtt/usecase"
	"icmongolang/pkg/logger"

	"github.com/go-chi/render"
)

// Cache interface สำหรับ redis cache
type Cache interface {
	Get(ctx context.Context, key string, dst interface{}) error
	Set(ctx context.Context, key string, value interface{}, ttl time.Duration) error
}

// MQTTHandler HTTP handler สำหรับ MQTT
type MQTTHandler struct {
	uc     usecase.MQTTUseCase
	logger logger.Logger
	cache  Cache
}

// NewMQTTHandler returns a new MQTTHandler with cache
func NewMQTTHandler(uc usecase.MQTTUseCase, log logger.Logger, cache Cache) *MQTTHandler {
	return &MQTTHandler{uc: uc, logger: log, cache: cache}
}

// CreateMQTTHandler creates a new MQTT HTTP handler with cache
func CreateMQTTHandler(uc usecase.MQTTUseCase, log logger.Logger, cache Cache) *MQTTHandler {
	return &MQTTHandler{uc: uc, logger: log, cache: cache}
}

// Publish godoc
// @Summary      Publish an MQTT message
// @Description  Publishes a payload to a specified MQTT topic
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.PublishRequest true "Publish request"
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.PublishResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/publish [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) Publish(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req presenter.PublishRequest
	if err := render.DecodeJSON(r.Body, &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("decode publish request error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequest(err))
		return
	}

	if req.Topic == "" {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("topic is required"))
		return
	}
	if req.Payload == nil {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("payload is required"))
		return
	}

	if err := h.uc.Publish(r.Context(), &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("publish error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInternal(err))
		return
	}

	render.JSON(w, r, presenter.PublishResponse{
		Success: true,
		Message: "published successfully",
	})
}

// Subscribe godoc
// @Summary      Subscribe to an MQTT topic
// @Description  Subscribes to a topic and starts receiving messages
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.SubscribeRequest true "Subscribe request"
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.SubscribeResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/subscribe [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) Subscribe(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req presenter.SubscribeRequest
	if err := render.DecodeJSON(r.Body, &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("decode subscribe request error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequest(err))
		return
	}

	if req.Topic == "" {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("topic is required"))
		return
	}
	if req.QoS > 2 {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("QoS must be 0, 1, or 2"))
		return
	}

	if err := h.uc.Subscribe(r.Context(), &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("subscribe error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInternal(err))
		return
	}

	render.JSON(w, r, presenter.SubscribeResponse{
		Topic:        req.Topic,
		QoS:          req.QoS,
		SubscribedAt: time.Now(),
		Message:      "subscribed successfully",
	})
}

// Unsubscribe godoc
// @Summary      Unsubscribe from an MQTT topic
// @Description  Unsubscribes from a previously subscribed topic
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.UnsubscribeRequest true "Unsubscribe request"
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.UnsubscribeResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/unsubscribe [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) Unsubscribe(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var req presenter.UnsubscribeRequest
	if err := render.DecodeJSON(r.Body, &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("decode unsubscribe request error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequest(err))
		return
	}

	if req.Topic == "" {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("topic is required"))
		return
	}

	if err := h.uc.Unsubscribe(r.Context(), &req); err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("unsubscribe error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInternal(err))
		return
	}

	render.JSON(w, r, presenter.UnsubscribeResponse{
		Success: true,
		Topic:   req.Topic,
		Message: "unsubscribed successfully",
	})
}

// Subscriptions godoc
// @Summary      List subscribed topics
// @Description  Returns all topics that are currently subscribed
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Produce      json
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.SubscriptionsResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/subscriptions [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) Subscriptions(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	topics := h.uc.GetSubscriptions()
	render.JSON(w, r, presenter.SubscriptionsResponse{
		Topics: topics,
		Count:  len(topics),
	})
}

// Status godoc
// @Summary      Get MQTT connection status
// @Description  Returns whether the MQTT client is connected to the broker
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Produce      json
// @Success      200 {object} map[string]interface{}
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/status [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) Status(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	connected := h.uc.IsConnected()
	status := "connected"
	if !connected {
		status = "disconnected"
	}

	TimeLoc, _ := time.LoadLocation("Asia/Bangkok")
	if TimeLoc == nil {
		TimeLoc = time.FixedZone("Bangkok", 7*60*60)
	}

	render.JSON(w, r, map[string]interface{}{
		"connected": connected,
		"status":    status,
		"timestamp": time.Now().In(TimeLoc).Format("2006-01-02 15:04:05"),
	})
}

// GetTopicData godoc
// @Summary      Get MQTT topic data (request-response)
// @Description  Returns the latest message from a specific MQTT topic, with caching
// @Tags         mqtt
// @Produce      json
// @Param        topic query string true "MQTT topic name"
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.MQTTTopicDataResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /mqtt/gettopicdata [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *MQTTHandler) GetTopicData(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	topic := r.URL.Query().Get("topic")
	if topic == "" {
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInvalidRequestString("topic is required"))
		return
	}

	ctx := r.Context()
	cacheKey := "mqtt_topic_data:" + fmt.Sprintf("%x", md5.Sum([]byte(topic)))
	var cachedData []byte
	if h.cache != nil {
		if err := h.cache.Get(ctx, cacheKey, &cachedData); err == nil && len(cachedData) > 0 {
			render.JSON(w, r, presenter.MQTTTopicDataResponse{
				StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
				Code:       200,
				Topic:      topic,
				Payload:    processPayload(cachedData),
				From:       "cache",
				Timestamp:  time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
				Message:    "from cache",
			})
			return
		}
	}

	data, err := h.uc.GetTopic(ctx, topic, 10*time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		h.logger.Errorf("GetTopic error: %v", err)
		render.Render(w, r, ErrInternal(err))
		return
	}

	if h.cache != nil {
		_ = h.cache.Set(ctx, cacheKey, data, 60*time.Second)
	}

	render.JSON(w, r, presenter.MQTTTopicDataResponse{
		StatusCode: http.StatusOK,
		Code:       200,
		Topic:      topic,
		Payload:    processPayload(data),
		From:       "mqtt",
		Timestamp:  time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339),
		Message:    "live data",
	})
}

// processPayload แปลง payload ให้อยู่ในรูปแบบที่ใช้งานง่าย (JSON object → CSV, หรือ array)
func processPayload(data []byte) interface{} {
	str := strings.TrimSpace(string(data))
	var jsonObj map[string]interface{}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &jsonObj); err == nil {
		values := make([]string, 0, len(jsonObj))
		for _, v := range jsonObj {
			values = append(values, fmt.Sprintf("%v", v))
		}
		return strings.Join(values, ",")
	}
	if strings.Contains(str, ",") {
		return strings.Split(str, ",")
	}
	return str
}

// Error helpers
func ErrInvalidRequest(err error) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest, ErrorText: err.Error()}
}

func ErrInternal(err error) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusInternalServerError, ErrorText: err.Error()}
}

func ErrInvalidRequestString(msg string) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest, ErrorText: msg}
}

type errResponse struct {
	HTTPStatusCode int    `json:"-"`
	ErrorText      string `json:"error"`
}

func (e *errResponse) Render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	render.Status(r, e.HTTPStatusCode)
	return nil
}
```

## 6. แก้ไข `internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/routes.go` (เพิ่ม route `GET /gettopicdata`)

```go
// internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/routes.go
package http

import (
	"sync"

	"icmongolang/internal/middleware"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

var (
	once sync.Once
)

func MapMQTTRoutes(router chi.Router, h *MQTTHandler, mw *middleware.MiddlewareManager) {
	once.Do(func() {
		if router == nil {
			panic("MapMQTTRoutes: router is nil")
		}
		if h == nil {
			panic("MapMQTTRoutes: handler is nil")
		}
		if mw == nil {
			panic("MapMQTTRoutes: middleware manager is nil")
		}

		router.Route("/mqtt", func(r chi.Router) {
			verifier := mw.Verifier(true)
			authenticator := mw.Authenticator()
			currentUser := mw.CurrentUser()
			activeUser := mw.ActiveUser()

			if verifier == nil || authenticator == nil || currentUser == nil || activeUser == nil {
				panic("MapMQTTRoutes: one or more middleware functions returned nil")
			}

			r.Group(func(r chi.Router) {
				r.Use(verifier)
				r.Use(authenticator)
				r.Use(currentUser)
				r.Use(activeUser)

				r.Post("/publish", h.Publish)
				r.Post("/subscribe", h.Subscribe)
				r.Post("/unsubscribe", h.Unsubscribe)
				r.Get("/subscriptions", h.Subscriptions)
				r.Get("/status", h.Status)
				// เพิ่ม route สำหรับ GetTopicData
				r.Get("/gettopicdata", h.GetTopicData)
			})
		})
	})
}
```

## 7. แก้ไข `internal/server/handlers.go` (inject redisCache และ influxClient ให้ MQTT)

```go
// internal/server/handlers.go (เฉพาะส่วนที่เกี่ยวข้อง, โค้ดเดิมให้คงไว้)
package server

import (
	"net/http"
	"time"

	_ "icmongolang/docs"
	httpSwagger "icmongolang/pkg/http-swagger"

	"icmongolang/internal/modules/alarm/repository"
	"icmongolang/internal/websocket"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
	"github.com/go-chi/cors"
	"github.com/go-chi/render"

	"github.com/hibiken/asynq"
	"github.com/redis/go-redis/v9"
	"gorm.io/gorm"

	"icmongolang/config"
	alarmHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/alarm/delivery/http"
	alarmUsecase "icmongolang/internal/modules/alarm/usecase"
	authHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/auth/delivery/http"
	influxHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/influxdb/delivery/http"
	influxUsecase "icmongolang/internal/modules/influxdb/usecase"
	itemHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/items/delivery/http"
	itemRepository "icmongolang/internal/modules/items/repository"
	itemUseCase "icmongolang/internal/modules/items/usecase"
	apiMiddleware "icmongolang/internal/middleware"
	mqttHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http"
	mqttUsecase "icmongolang/internal/modules/mqtt/usecase"
	userHttp "icmongolang/internal/modules/users/delivery/http"
	userDistributor "icmongolang/internal/modules/users/distributor"
	userRepository "icmongolang/internal/modules/users/repository"
	userUseCase "icmongolang/internal/modules/users/usecase"
	"icmongolang/pkg/influxdb"
	"icmongolang/pkg/logger"
	"icmongolang/pkg/mqtt"
	redisPkg "icmongolang/pkg/redis" // import alias

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/promhttp"
)

// New สร้าง router หลัก
func New(
	db *gorm.DB,
	redisClient *redis.Client,
	taskRedisClient *asynq.Client,
	cfg *config.Config,
	logger logger.Logger,
	influxClient *influxdb.InfluxClient,
	mqttClient mqtt.Client,
) (*chi.Mux, error) {
	r := chi.NewRouter()

	// ========== 1. Repositories, UseCases ==========
	userPgRepo := userRepository.CreateUserPgRepository(db)
	userRedisRepo := userRepository.CreateUserRedisRepository(redisClient)
	itemPgRepo := itemRepository.CreateItemPgRepository(db)

	userRedisTaskDistributor := userDistributor.NewUserRedisTaskDistributor(taskRedisClient, cfg, logger)

	userUC := userUseCase.CreateUserUseCaseI(userPgRepo, userRedisRepo, userRedisTaskDistributor, cfg, logger)
	itemUC := itemUseCase.CreateItemUseCaseI(itemPgRepo, cfg, logger)

	// ========== 2. Middleware Manager ==========
	mw := apiMiddleware.CreateMiddlewareManager(cfg, logger, userUC)
	apiMiddleware.StartMetricsCollector(redisClient)

	// ========== 3. Global middleware ==========
	r.Use(middleware.Recoverer)
	r.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	r.Use(middleware.RealIP)
	r.Use(middleware.URLFormat)
	r.Use(apiMiddleware.MonitoringMiddleware)
	r.Use(middleware.Logger)
	r.Use(middleware.Timeout(time.Duration(cfg.Server.ProcessTimeout) * time.Second))
	r.Use(render.SetContentType(render.ContentTypeJSON))
	r.Use(cors.Handler(mw.Cors()))

	// ========== 4. API sub-router ==========
	apiRouter := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Mount("/api", apiRouter)

	// ========== 5. Handlers ==========
	userHandler := userHttp.CreateUserHandler(userUC, cfg, logger)
	authHandler := authHttp.CreateAuthHandler(userUC, cfg, logger)
	itemHandler := itemHttp.CreateItemHandler(itemUC, cfg, logger)

	// ========== 6. InfluxDB routes ==========
	if influxClient != nil {
		influxUC := influxUsecase.NewInfluxUseCase(influxClient, logger)
		influxHandler := influxHttp.CreateInfluxHandler(influxUC, logger)
		influxHttp.MapInfluxRoutes(apiRouter, influxHandler, mw)
		logger.Info("InfluxDB routes registered")
	}

	// ========== 7. MQTT routes (พร้อม cache และ influx) ==========
	// สร้าง Redis cache
	redisCache := redisPkg.NewCache(redisClient)

	// สร้าง WebSocket hub (ถ้ายังไม่มี)
	wsHub := websocket.NewHub()
	go wsHub.Run()

	// สร้าง AlarmLog repository
	alarmLogRepo := repository.NewAlarmLogRepository(db)

	if mqttClient != nil && mqttClient.IsConnected() {
		// ใช้ constructor ที่รับ influxClient และ WebSocket hub
		mqttUC, err := mqttUsecase.NewMQTTUseCaseWithClientAndWS(
			mqttClient, cfg, logger, wsHub, db, alarmLogRepo, influxClient,
		)
		if err != nil {
			logger.Errorf("สร้าง MQTT usecase ไม่สำเร็จ: %v", err)
		} else {
			mqttHandler := mqttHttp.CreateMQTTHandler(mqttUC, logger, redisCache)
			mqttHttp.MapMQTTRoutes(apiRouter, mqttHandler, mw)
			logger.Info("MQTT routes registered with Cache, WebSocket & InfluxDB")
		}
	} else {
		logger.Warn("MQTT client not connected, skipping MQTT routes")
	}

	// ========== 8. Alarm routes ==========
	alarmUC := alarmUsecase.NewAlarmUseCase()
	alarmHandler := alarmHttp.NewAlarmHandler(alarmUC, logger)
	alarmHttp.MapAlarmRoutes(apiRouter, alarmHandler, mw)

	// ========== 9. Other routes ==========
	authHttp.MapAuthRoute(apiRouter, authHandler, mw)
	userHttp.MapUserRoute(apiRouter, userHandler, mw)
	itemHttp.MapItemRoute(apiRouter, itemHandler, mw)

	// WebSocket route (ไม่มี auth)
	apiRouter.Get("/ws", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		websocket.ServeWS(wsHub, w, r)
	})

	// Metrics
	r.Get("/apimetric", apiMiddleware.MetricsHandler)
	r.Get("/metrics", promhttp.Handler().ServeHTTP)

	// Swagger
	r.Get("/swagger/*", httpSwagger.Handler(httpSwagger.URL("/swagger/doc.json")))

	// Ping
	apiRouter.Get("/ping", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		render.Respond(w, r, "pong")
	})

	return r, nil
}
```

**ผลลัพธ์:** ได้ API `GET /api/mqtt/gettopicdata?topic=XXX` ที่รองรับ cache (Redis) และสามารถบันทึกข้อมูล MQTT ที่ subscribe ลง InfluxDB พร้อมทั้งมี alarm validation จาก logic TypeScript ที่移植มาแล้ว
